<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Parliamentary discourse:</strong> Opposition leaders, including Rahul Gandhi and Kapil Sibal, are pushing for more direct and uninterrupted Q&amp;A sessions with the government in Parliament to enhance accountability.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Opposition strategy:</strong> TMC leader Derek O&#x27;Brien emphasized that while regional friction between the Congress and AAP is natural, the broader opposition remains united in its stance against the BJP.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a></span></li>
